From: admin.ward5@central-hospital.org
To: safety@clinicverse.com
Subject: Possible medication reaction - unsure
Date: 2025-09-09T16:10:00Z

Hello,

We had a patient on Ward 5 who may have had some kind of reaction,
but I'm not sure if it qualifies as a reportable event.

Patient: male, approximately 65 years old (I don't have the exact
details right now - the chart is with the attending).

He was on several medications including something for blood pressure
and a diuretic. Around day 4 of admission he started looking a bit
jaundiced - yellowish skin and eyes. The lab work showed elevated
liver enzymes but I don't have the exact numbers.

The attending thinks it might be related to the blood pressure
medication but isn't certain. He said it could also be related to
the patient's pre-existing liver condition.

The diuretic was stopped "just in case" but the blood pressure
medication was continued.

I'm filing this because I wasn't sure what the threshold is for
reporting. The patient is stable and not in any acute distress.
He's scheduled for discharge tomorrow.

Can someone advise if this needs a formal report?

Thanks,
Ward 5 Admin
Central Hospital
Phone: (555) 234-5678
